findings.body: If a federated source mesh is copied into a retained viewport wrapper and its `positions` field is then reassigned in place before bounded release, this set contains only the new position buffer. The wrapper still holds the original buffer, but `sharesCpuBuffer` leaves that field untouched, so releasing the source does not free the retained CPU geometry.
